notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing"; then "What color / size for each room? tell me". Tumble (tumbleliving.com, read in Chrome 2026-10-26; no photo: the host is off the image allowlist): a two-piece washable system, a 1/8" thick 100% polyester rug with a spillproof face (liquids bead up) on a separate 1/4" cushioned non-slip pad (EVA foam core, TPR surfaces) that tucks into corner pockets; the pad is included in the price ("Pad included - $179 value" at 8x10). Care: "All rug sizes fit into a standard household washer and dryer", cold cycle, standard detergent, dry on low heat; sweep or vacuum under the pad every 3 months; "We don't recommend using autonomous robot vacuums as they've been known to damage the rug's edges". Prices, the same for every design read: 9x12 $549, 8x10 $399, 6x9 $349, 5x7 $199, 3x5 $129, runners $149 and $199. Free shipping and 30-day returns. Color notes on the page: "Harmonious shades of light and mid-toned neutrals are paired with earth toned shades of clay and light gold. The border is a warm grey and smaller motifs are a cool ivory"; a Persian with a decorative fringe, Tumble's best seller. The warmer alternative for the living room: clay and light gold read closer to the honey oak than the Olivia's cool ivory, so it blends where the Olivia lifts; kept as the second choice (F-68: pale fields under dark pieces). Sold on Amazon as amazon-B0HCMZGWDH at the same price (Andrew's link, 2026-10-26, night): the Amazon record is the one placed (living L) and the one to order; this one is the maker's reference.
